title: Heartstopper Forever
plot_overview: As a new school year begins, a young couple’s relationship deepens while they consider what comes after graduation. With university, travel, and time apart on the horizon, they face questions about growing up and how their future might shape their bond.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you’re drawn to heartfelt queer romance, tender emotional moments, and stories about growing up together; Not for you if you prefer brisk pacing or a light, uncomplicated finale.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt romance; mature emotional themes; warm, hopeful tone | Cons: rushed pacing; limited supporting stories; uneven writing
